changelog:
- Initial release of live-atr-sizing.
- Provides live ATR-based position sizing recommendations using real-time volatility from APEX Runner.
- Supports Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, and Hyperliquid exchanges.
- Simple authenticated GET request; no API key, account, or subscription required—just pay per call with an EVM wallet.
- Early adopters receive automatic discounts on per-call pricing based on usage tiers.
summary: Live ATR-based position sizing recommendation for current volatility
